finding: AXES advertises grid_h valid=6, but generate(..., difficulty='medium', grid_h=7) accepts the override, returns a 7-row grid, and self_check accepts it. The metadata/API boundary is therefore not enforced.
limitations: One valid/metadata-invalid comparison was executed; other axes were not audited.
No claim is made about semantic rule correctness or output packing.
suggested_repair: Align AXES with the intended variable-size contract, or enforce grid_h=6 with an exact override gate; add a boundary test for 6 versus 7.
